loading.readiness: document complete; exactly one data-rd003-ready=true marker and intended target; every image complete with positive naturalWidth
loading.network: All routed requests abort; any request fails the case. Data image embedded; no server or external assets.
loading.failure: One supervised Node process per state. Only timely exited output may be accepted; forced stop suppresses late output, records failed/cleanup-unverified, and stops remaining states. Graceful closes occur before output; no async timeout race. Any forced/uncertain cleanup remains unverified and stops; a process inventory is diagnostic only and can never clear that status. Recovery requires separately scoped inspection and owner direction.

scanner.coverage: Validate all four transient arrays and each rule's occurrence in at least one bucket. A rule may occur in several. Unknown rules, duplicate rule per bucket, rule error or malformed rule/node collection are fatal. Missing/malformed individual check groups/IDs remain unavailable facts on the existing observation.
scanner.frequency: Once per frozen state, provider-independent; no repeatability claim.

evidencePolicy.scope: Only these controlled authored fixtures. Public-runtime field/locator implementation belongs to M1.
evidencePolicy.provenance: Manifest/scenario/revision/state/stable target key are evaluation metadata, not native page identity. Browser and engine versions are verified at execution. Locator is supporting evidence only and excluded from retrieval/provider payloads.
evidencePolicy.retention: Declared failing-rule nodes, every native incomplete node, and exactly one corrected same-target pass. Other passes/inapplicable remain transient; coverage retains only rule/bucket node counts.

sharedFields.nativeBucket: containing native array, never derived from absence or ratio
sharedFields.checks: native node.any/all/none[*].id; exact per-rule/group membership, no duplicates; no invented per-check booleans; absent/null group missing, malformed/unknown/duplicate IDs invalid; preserve the item
sharedFields.locator: native node.target exactly one unchanged string equal to case selector, <=64 characters, unique top-level match of expected element kind; otherwise missing/invalid/withheld/ambiguous; absent/null missing, other malformed shape invalid, non-allowlisted/oversized string withheld, non-unique match ambiguous; invalid element kind remains invalid
sharedFields.targetMatch: DOM resolution of native selector, never fixture-key substitution

evidencePolicy.unavailability: Individual unavailable facts are nested {unavailable: missing|invalid|withheld|ambiguous}; preserve their item. Required missing facts fail this case's evidence expectation. Missing locator does not itself establish generation insufficiency; no product generation policy is implemented.

domFields.elementKind: Unique native-target element tag, closed to case kind
domFields.inputType: input.type must be email; no value
domFields.namingAttributes: aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, placeholder -> absent|empty|whitespace-only|nonempty; attribute presence only, not resolved name
domFields.explicitAssociation: input.labels whose for matches input id and label.control===input -> none|one|multiple; no IDs or label text retained
domFields.implicitAssociation: input.labels without for, containing input with label.control===input -> none|one|multiple
domFields.bounds: Attribute strings >256 characters withheld, not truncated; image source/form values/text/HTML never returned

evidencePolicy.nativeExplicitNameState: label node.any[id=explicit-label].data.explicitLabel -> empty|nonempty; missing/null missing, non-string invalid, >256 withheld. Optional for failing state; corrected explicit-label case requires nonempty. No raw name retained.

contrastFields.contrastRatio: same data.contrastRatio; finite number 1..21, unchanged; no recomputation
contrastFields.expectedContrastRatio: same data.expectedContrastRatio; exact 3:1|4.5:1; controlled normal text requires 4.5:1
contrastFields.fontSize: same data.fontSize; <=48 characters, positive finite numeric pt (px) grammar, each component <=4096; unchanged; string length >48 withheld, malformed grammar/numeric bounds invalid

evidencePolicy.nativeReason: Contrast check data.messageKey only from reasonValues; unknown string withheld; absent/null missing; other type invalid. For other-rule incomplete, missing reason is explicit. Bucket remains authoritative.
evidencePolicy.excluded: Raw scanner payload/HTML, screenshots/traces, DOM/accessibility snapshots, arbitrary text or hidden content, URLs, source attributes, input values, raw name strings, messages/failureSummary, relatedNodes, credentials, general pass/inapplicable archives, independent child identities.

profiles.manualBoundary: Image purpose and appropriate wording are author gold/manual judgment; corrected alternative is Blue square.
Explicit visible Email address label association; no SC 1.3.1/3.3.2 claim; wording/instructions need human judgment.
Normal 16px weight 400 text; classification, exceptions, and context need human judgment; native bucket controls.

changeRule: Any change to frozen content, expectations, profile or policy creates a new version and affected-case evidence, preserving prior inputs/results. Never change an expectation to fit an observation.
limitations: Exactly three profiles/six states; no extra fixtures or routine repeated batches.
No product/public-URL behavior, providers/models/corpus/generation packages, statistical quality, accessibility conformance, hostile-page safety, support qualification, or release claim.
Native incomplete observations are retained distinctly if encountered; none is manufactured.
Comparison-only vector stays with its existing authority for M5; no added browser execution.
